lessons.titleEn: at the speed of a swipe

brief.meaningEn: Spread very quickly through phone-based sharing and feeds.
brief.meaningZh: 透過手機分享和動態消息迅速傳開。
brief.grammar: A contemporary speed image, not a measurable physical speed or a claim that every viewer shared it.
brief.boundaryZh: 短時間曝光可以很廣，但不代表訊息已被核實或會持久。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把迅速傳播誤作傳播者已仔細閱讀。
brief.outcomeZh: 能解釋甚麼內容經由甚麼渠道迅速傳開。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 46, row 4; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: New trends now spread at the speed of a swipe.
sources.expression: at the speed of a swipe

options.en: People forwarded it rapidly through phone groups.
options.zh: 人們透過手機群組迅速轉發。

options.en: The cook printed copies for every district.
options.zh: 廚師為每區印了食譜。

options.en: The recipe was posted only after lunch.
options.zh: 食譜到午飯後才貼出。

options.en: Residents needed several weeks to hear about it.
options.zh: 居民過了幾星期才聽到。

listening.explanationZh: 群組轉發令食譜在上午迅速傳開。
listening.en: A neighbourhood cook posted a short recipe at breakfast. By lunch, residents in several districts had passed it through phone groups; it travelled at the speed of a swipe.
listening.zh: 一位街坊廚師在早餐時貼出短食譜。到了午飯時間，幾區居民已在手機群組轉發；它像滑動螢幕般迅速傳開。

options.en: It reached them between breakfast and lunch.
options.zh: 它在早餐至午飯之間傳到其他區。

options.en: Phone groups helped it spread within hours.
options.zh: 手機群組令它在幾小時內傳開。

options.en: It spread at the speed of a swipe.
options.zh: 它像滑動螢幕般迅速傳開。

options.en: Forwarding made the spread unusually fast.
options.zh: 轉發令傳播速度特別快。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都描述數小時內由手機轉發；金句採用來源速度意象。
reply.promptEn: How quickly did the recipe reach other districts?

scene.promptZh: 社區義工剛發出一則尋狗啟事，兩小時內多個屋苑群組都看見，但仍未找到狗。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The notice travelled at the speed of a swipe, although the search is still under way.
options.zh: 啟事像滑動螢幕般迅速傳開，但搜尋仍在進行。

options.en: The notice reached only the original group.
options.zh: 啟事只傳到最初的群組。

options.en: Wide sharing proves the dog has already been found.
options.zh: 廣泛轉發證明狗已找到。

scene.explanationZh: 迅速轉發不等於搜尋已有結果。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句最準確指出此說法的限制？

options.en: Fast sharing does not prove a post is accurate.
options.zh: 迅速轉發不代表貼文準確。

options.en: A swipe is an official unit for measuring network speed.
options.zh: 滑動是量度網絡速度的正式單位。

options.en: A fast post is automatically memorable for years.
options.zh: 傳得快的貼文一定令人記住多年。

contrast.explanationZh: 速度意象不等於驗證真確性或長期影響。

dialogue.promptZh: 同學問：「學校賣物會的消息為何半天內傳到其他班？」你知道班長把海報分享到幾個手機群組。哪句最完整？

options.en: The poster spread at the speed of a swipe after class leaders shared it across phone groups.
options.zh: 班長在多個手機群組分享海報後，消息像滑動螢幕般迅速傳開。

options.en: Several class leaders shared the poster.
options.zh: 幾位班長分享了海報。

options.en: The news reached other classes by midday.
options.zh: 消息在中午前傳到其他班。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句兼述迅速傳播及具體渠道。

speaking.en: The recipe crossed several neighbourhood groups at the speed of a swipe.
speaking.zh: 食譜像滑動螢幕般迅速傳遍幾個街坊群組。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出它經甚麼渠道傳開。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：一個青年劇團貼出免費工作坊報名連結；學生把連結轉到各校手機群組，當晚已有多校報名。用一至兩句英文描述傳播，並避免聲稱人人都參加。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出手機群組與短時間傳播；報名數增加不等於所有學生參與。

examples.en: The workshop link spread at the speed of a swipe through school phone groups, bringing registrations from several schools that evening.
examples.zh: 工作坊連結透過學校手機群組像滑動螢幕般迅速傳開，當晚帶來幾間學校的報名。

examples.en: Students forwarded the invitation through school phone groups at the speed of a swipe; by evening, the theatre group had sign-ups from several campuses.
examples.zh: 學生在學校手機群組像滑動螢幕般迅速轉發邀請；到了晚上，劇團收到幾間學校的報名。

takeaways.en: The notice travelled at the speed of a swipe, but the details still needed checking.
takeaways.zh: 啟事像滑動螢幕般迅速傳開，但細節仍須核實。

takeaways.en: A clever caption can spread at the speed of a swipe without staying popular for long.
takeaways.zh: 巧妙的說明文字可像滑動螢幕般迅速傳開，卻未必長久受歡迎。

lessons.titleZh: 淹沒在不斷更新的貼文中

brief.meaningEn: Stop attracting attention as newer online posts push past, even if the content remains available.
brief.meaningZh: 較新的網上貼文不斷出現，使內容雖仍可找到，卻不再受注意。
brief.grammar: The scroll means a continually moving feed, not deletion from a site.
brief.boundaryZh: 失去曝光不等於檔案已刪除，也不代表內容本身沒有價值。
brief.misconceptionZh: 此處重點是注意力消退，而非手機故障或畫面不能捲動。
brief.outcomeZh: 能分清貼文仍存在與讀者不再看見它。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 46, row 10; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: A popular clip may vanish into the scroll by next week.

options.en: It lost visibility among newer posts but was still online.
options.zh: 它在新貼文之間失去曝光，但仍在網上。

options.en: The group deliberately deleted its link.
options.zh: 團體刻意刪除了連結。

options.en: Viewers could no longer play any video on the site.
options.zh: 觀眾已不能播放網站上的任何影片。

options.en: The clip had never attracted attention.
options.zh: 短片從未引起注意。

listening.explanationZh: 短片仍存在，但動態消息中的位置與注意力已變。
listening.en: A wildlife group’s rescue clip attracted many views on Monday. By Friday, newer videos had filled the feed; the clip had vanished into the scroll, although its link still worked.
listening.zh: 野生動物團體的救援短片星期一吸引很多觀看。到星期五，較新的影片佔滿動態消息；短片已淹沒在不斷更新的貼文中，雖然連結仍可開啟。

reply.promptZh: （救援短片到星期五有甚麼變化？）

options.en: New posts drew attention away from it.
options.zh: 新貼文把注意力帶走。

options.en: People could still open the link, but fewer saw it in the feed.
options.zh: 人們仍可開連結，但較少在動態消息看見它。

options.en: It vanished into the scroll.
options.zh: 它淹沒在不斷更新的貼文中。

options.en: Its earlier popularity no longer kept it prominent.
options.zh: 先前受歡迎也未能令它一直顯眼。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都指短片仍在網上，但曝光消退。
reply.promptEn: What happened to the rescue clip by Friday?

scene.promptZh: 校園攝影比賽貼文仍能透過連結打開，但新貼文太多，學生在動態消息幾乎看不到。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The competition post has vanished into the scroll.
options.zh: 比賽貼文淹沒在不斷更新的貼文中。

options.en: The school removed the competition post from its site.
options.zh: 學校從網站刪除了比賽貼文。

options.en: The link has become easier to find in the feed.
options.zh: 連結如今更容易在動態消息找到。

scene.explanationZh: 內容未刪除，只是較少出現在讀者眼前。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句錯把注意力消退當成檔案刪除？

options.en: New posts can bury an older clip.
options.zh: 新貼文可以掩蓋較舊短片。

options.en: If it vanishes into the scroll, the server must have erased it.
options.zh: 若它淹沒在貼文中，伺服器一定已把它刪除。

options.en: An older link may still open normally.
options.zh: 較舊連結仍可能正常開啟。

contrast.explanationZh: 比喻指不再顯眼，不能推出伺服器刪檔。

dialogue.promptZh: 社團問：「去年得獎者的短片明明還在，為何沒人看見？」你知道平台每天加入大量新片。哪句最完整？

options.en: It has vanished into the scroll as new clips arrive; share the working link again if you want people to revisit it.
options.zh: 新片不斷出現，它已淹沒在不斷更新的貼文中；想讓大家重看，可以再分享仍有效的連結。

options.en: The link still works.
options.zh: 連結仍然有效。

options.en: New videos arrive every day.
options.zh: 每天都有新影片加入。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句解釋注意力消退並提出具體方法。

speaking.en: The rescue clip vanished into the scroll even though its link still worked.
speaking.zh: 救援短片雖然連結仍可開啟，卻淹沒在不斷更新的貼文中。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再分清「不再顯眼」與「已被刪除」。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：學生會曾發布畢業生口述歷史短片；幾個月後連結仍有效，卻被每日新貼文蓋過。學生會想重新推介這批故事。用一至兩句英文說明情況。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出連結仍有效但曝光下降，並提出重新推介的方法。

examples.en: The oral-history clips have vanished into the scroll despite working links, so the council can feature them again in a new post.
examples.zh: 口述歷史短片的連結仍有效，卻淹沒在不斷更新的貼文中；學生會可用新貼文再次推介。

examples.en: The stories did not disappear from the archive; they vanished into the scroll, so a pinned collection could make them visible again.
examples.zh: 故事並未從檔案庫消失，而是淹沒在不斷更新的貼文中；置頂合集可令它們再次顯眼。

takeaways.en: An old appeal can vanish into the scroll without losing its importance.
takeaways.zh: 舊呼籲可淹沒在不斷更新的貼文中，卻不會因此失去重要性。

takeaways.en: The interview vanished into the scroll, so the editor shared its link again.
takeaways.zh: 訪問淹沒在不斷更新的貼文中，所以編輯再次分享連結。

brief.meaningEn: Still visibly successful or significant despite a prominent competitor.
brief.meaningZh: 即使有顯眼的競爭者，仍相當受重視或表現出色。
brief.grammar: The phrase denies the expected shadow metaphor; it does not mean competition is absent.
brief.register: Cultural comparisons, markets and public events.
brief.boundaryZh: 須有仍受關注的證據；不能僅憑存在便斷言未被蓋過風頭。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把 far from 誤解成兩者地理位置相隔很遠。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出哪項具體成績顯示本地選項仍受重視。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 51, row 13; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Local bands are far from being overshadowed by imports.

listening.promptZh: 甚麼顯示本地工匠仍受關注？

options.en: Visitors continued to queue at their stalls.
options.zh: 訪客繼續在他們的攤位排隊。

options.en: The international fair had no visitors.
options.zh: 國際工藝展沒有訪客。

options.en: The local stalls were moved overseas.
options.zh: 本地攤位搬到海外。

options.en: Every visitor bought only imported goods.
options.zh: 每位訪客都只買進口貨。

listening.explanationZh: 本地攤位持續有人排隊，是未被掩蓋的證據。
listening.en: An international craft fair opened beside a local makers’ market. Visitors still queued for the local stalls all weekend, so the local artisans were far from being overshadowed by the larger event.
listening.zh: 國際工藝展在本地手作市集旁開幕。整個週末，訪客仍在本地攤位排隊，因此本地工匠遠未被較大型展覽蓋過風頭。

reply.promptZh: （本地手作人在國際工藝展旁表現如何？）

options.en: Their stalls still attracted long queues.
options.zh: 他們的攤位仍吸引長龍。

options.en: They remained visible despite the larger event.
options.zh: 即使有較大型活動，他們仍受注目。

options.en: They were far from being overshadowed.
options.zh: 他們遠未被蓋過風頭。

options.en: The competing event did not erase local interest.
options.zh: 競爭活動沒有抹去本地興趣。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都指出本地攤位繼續受關注。
reply.promptEn: How did the local makers do beside the international fair?

scene.promptZh: 國際影展在同一週開幕，本地電影放映仍連續三晚滿座。哪句最貼切？

options.en: Even with the international festival in town, the local films are far from being overshadowed.
options.zh: 即使國際影展同時舉行，本地電影仍遠未被蓋過風頭。

options.en: The local sellouts prove the visiting films drew fewer viewers overall.
options.zh: 本地場次售罄證明外地電影整體觀眾較少。

options.en: The local screenings attracted no one.
options.zh: 本地放映沒有人觀看。

scene.explanationZh: 本地放映滿座，不代表競爭活動失敗。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句把 far from 誤作物理距離？

options.en: The smaller event still drew attention.
options.zh: 較小型活動仍受到注意。

options.en: The bands must be many kilometres apart.
options.zh: 樂隊一定相距很多公里。

options.en: The local group can stay important beside imports.
options.zh: 本地團體可與進口作品並存而仍重要。

contrast.explanationZh: far from 在此加強否定，不指兩者的實際距離。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「外地劇團來了，本地劇團一定沒觀眾吧？」你知道本地場次已售罄。哪句最完整？

options.en: Our local group is far from being overshadowed; its shows sold out even with the visiting company in town.
options.zh: 本地劇團遠未被蓋過風頭；即使外地劇團來訪，本地場次仍售罄。

options.en: The local shows sold out.
options.zh: 本地場次售罄。

options.en: Both groups can draw audiences.
options.zh: 兩個劇團都可以吸引觀眾。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句用售罄作未被蓋過風頭的證據。

speaking.en: The local stalls were far from being overshadowed by the larger fair.
speaking.zh: 本地攤位遠未被較大型展覽蓋過風頭。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說出支持這個判斷的證據。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：海外串流平台在本地推出新劇，社區劇院同月每場門票都售罄，並增設一場演出。用一至兩句英文比較關注度。
writing.selfCheckZh: 用售罄和加場作證，不要說海外平台完全沒人看。

examples.en: The community theatre is far from being overshadowed by the new streaming service: its performances sold out and it added another show.
examples.zh: 社區劇院遠未被新串流服務蓋過風頭：演出售罄，還加開一場。

examples.en: Even with imported shows online, the theatre is far from being overshadowed; full houses led to an extra performance.
examples.zh: 即使網上有外地劇集，劇院仍遠未被蓋過風頭；場場滿座促成加場。

takeaways.en: A smaller team can be far from being overshadowed if its work still attracts attention.
takeaways.zh: 較小的團隊若作品仍受關注，便遠未被蓋過風頭。

takeaways.en: The independent shop was far from being overshadowed by the chain next door.
takeaways.zh: 獨立商店遠未被隔壁連鎖店蓋過風頭。

brief.meaningEn: Memorable works or moments that mark important stages in someone’s emotional life.
brief.meaningZh: 標記人生重要情感階段、日後仍能喚起記憶的作品或時刻。
brief.grammar: Landmarks is a map metaphor; the reference points are in memory, not necessarily physical places.
brief.boundaryZh: 作品可以對某人有此意義，卻未必對所有人同樣重要。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不必是快樂回憶；關鍵是它們幫助回想人生不同階段。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 52, row 4; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Those songs became emotional landmarks in her life.

listening.promptZh: 那些廣播劇對艾蓮娜有甚麼意義？

options.en: They help her recall stages of her first year away.
options.zh: 它們讓她回想離家第一年的不同階段。

options.en: They were the only dramas broadcast that year.
options.zh: 它們是那年唯一播出的廣播劇。

options.en: They taught her a physical route to her new home.
options.zh: 它們教她到新家的實際路線。

options.en: Everyone who heard them had the same memories.
options.zh: 每位聽眾都有相同回憶。

listening.explanationZh: 作品把她的經歷和情感階段連起來。
listening.en: Three radio dramas followed Elena through her first year away from home. Hearing them again reminded her of the move, new friends and her first job; they had become emotional landmarks.
listening.zh: 三齣廣播劇陪伴艾蓮娜離家後的第一年。再次聽到時，她想起搬家、新朋友和第一份工作；這些劇成了她情感記憶的里程碑。

reply.promptZh: （艾蓮娜為何一再聽那些廣播劇？）

options.en: They reminded her of moving and making friends.
options.zh: 它們令她想起搬家和結交朋友。

options.en: They marked several stages of an important year.
options.zh: 它們標記了重要一年裏的幾個階段。

options.en: They became emotional landmarks for her.
options.zh: 它們成了她情感記憶的里程碑。

options.en: They connected particular sounds with personal memories.
options.zh: 它們把特定聲音與個人回憶連在一起。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都描述作品與她的人生記憶相連。
reply.promptEn: Why did Elena keep returning to the dramas?

lessons.titleZh: 在舒適程度上較勝一籌

brief.meaningEn: Be preferable on the particular measure of comfort, even if another option has other advantages.
brief.meaningZh: 在舒適程度這一項較有優勢，儘管另一選擇可能在其他方面較好。
brief.grammar: Win on X identifies the dimension of comparison; it does not claim overall superiority.
brief.register: Everyday choices about media, travel and facilities.
brief.boundaryZh: 較舒適不等於較便宜、較快或適合每個人。
brief.misconceptionZh: 須說清楚比較對象，以及讓人感到較舒適的具體因素。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx

sources.sentence: A recorded show may win on comfort after work.

listening.promptZh: 錄影在哪方面較有優勢？

options.en: It lets Omar rest at home after work.
options.zh: 它讓奧馬爾下班後在家休息。

options.en: It recreates every part of the live atmosphere.
options.zh: 它重現現場氣氛的每個細節。

options.en: It makes the concert ticket cheaper.
options.zh: 它令現場門票更便宜。

options.en: It shortens his late shift.
options.zh: 它縮短了他的晚班。

listening.explanationZh: 錄影的優勢是下班後可在家舒適休息。
listening.en: After a late shift, Omar considered travelling across town for a live concert or watching its recording at home. The live event had atmosphere, but the recording might win on comfort because he could rest on his sofa.
listening.zh: 晚班後，奧馬爾考慮橫越市區去看現場音樂會，或在家看錄影。現場氣氛好，但錄影可能在舒適程度上較勝一籌，因為他可以在梳化上休息。

reply.promptZh: （奧馬爾下班後為何可能選錄影？）

options.en: It avoids a journey across town.
options.zh: 它免去橫越市區的路程。

options.en: He can watch while resting on his sofa.
options.zh: 他可在梳化上休息時觀看。

options.en: The recording may win on comfort.
options.zh: 錄影可能在舒適程度上較勝一籌。

options.en: He can enjoy the performance without leaving home.
options.zh: 他毋須離家也可欣賞表演。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都說明在家觀看的舒適優勢；金句明確指出比較面向。
reply.promptEn: Why might Omar choose the recording after work?

scene.promptZh: 兩間自修室都有充足參考書，一間座位狹窄，另一間桌椅寬敞且安靜；學生比較讀書環境。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The quieter room wins on comfort for a long study session.
options.zh: 安靜的房間在長時間溫習的舒適程度上較勝一籌。

options.en: The quieter room must also have more books.
options.zh: 安靜的房間一定也有更多參考書。

options.en: The two rooms offer exactly the same seating experience.
options.zh: 兩個房間的座位體驗完全相同。

scene.explanationZh: 寬敞桌椅與安靜環境支持舒適方面的比較。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句把 on comfort 誤作所有方面都較好？

options.en: The recording may be easier to enjoy after a shift.
options.zh: 晚班後看錄影可能較輕鬆。

options.en: If it wins on comfort, it must also have the best sound and lowest cost.
options.zh: 它若較舒適，音質和價格也一定最優。

options.en: A live concert can still offer a stronger atmosphere.
options.zh: 現場音樂會的氣氛仍可能較好。

contrast.explanationZh: 舒適只是其中一個比較面向。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友問：「你不是更喜歡現場音樂嗎？今晚為何看錄影？」你剛下晚班，不想再乘車。哪句最完整？

options.en: Live music has better atmosphere, but the recording wins on comfort tonight because I can rest at home.
options.zh: 現場音樂氣氛較好，但今晚錄影在舒適程度上較勝一籌，因為我可在家休息。

options.en: I am tired after the late shift.
options.zh: 晚班後我累了。

options.en: I do not want to cross town tonight.
options.zh: 今晚我不想橫越市區。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句指出另一選項的優點和今晚選錄影的具體原因。

speaking.en: After work, the recording may win on comfort even though the live show has atmosphere.
speaking.zh: 下班後，錄影可能在舒適程度上較勝一籌，儘管現場演出氣氛較好。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出兩個選項各自的優勢。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：家人比較夜間長途巴士和臥鋪火車。巴士票較便宜，火車有可躺臥的床位；他們想翌日精神較好。用一至兩句英文說明取捨。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出火車的舒適優勢及巴士的價格優勢；不要斷言所有旅客都應選火車。

examples.en: The sleeper train may win on comfort because passengers can lie flat, although the coach costs less.
examples.zh: 臥鋪火車可能在舒適程度上較勝一籌，因為乘客可以躺下，雖然長途巴士較便宜。

examples.en: If rest matters most, the train wins on comfort; its berths offer room to sleep, while the coach saves money.
examples.zh: 若最重視休息，火車在舒適程度上較勝一籌；臥鋪提供睡眠空間，而長途巴士可省錢。

takeaways.en: The padded seat wins on comfort, though the lighter chair is easier to carry.
takeaways.zh: 軟墊座椅在舒適程度上較勝一籌，但較輕的椅子更易搬。

takeaways.en: A home replay may win on comfort without replacing every benefit of a live event.
takeaways.zh: 在家重看可能在舒適程度上較勝一籌，卻不能取代現場活動的所有好處。

options.zh: 她在分享前核對辦事處註明日期的通告。

options.zh: 她沒有核查便分享兩則貼文。

options.zh: 她假設較舊貼文一定正確。

options.zh: 她保持審慎判斷。

options.zh: 她把貼文與花園辦事處通告比較。

speaking.en: Hana kept a critical mind when two posts gave different opening dates.

takeaways.en: The editor kept a critical mind by checking the report’s date and source.

listening.zh: 學校就午膳排隊訪問教師，卻沒有問實際排隊的學生。結果只呈現片面的情況，因此校務委員會加做學生調查。

options.en: The first survey omitted the pupils’ experience.

options.en: The report gives a narrow picture of the whole district.
options.zh: 報告只呈現整區片面的情況。

options.en: The report includes every neighbourhood equally.
options.zh: 報告同等涵蓋每個社區。

options.en: The city-centre figures must all be false.

scene.explanationZh: 市中心數據可能準確，但不足以代表整區。

options.en: One source may miss an important viewpoint.
options.zh: 單一來源可能漏掉重要觀點。

options.en: A narrow picture means a photograph printed on thin paper.
options.zh: 片面的情況指印在薄紙上的照片。

options.en: A further survey can widen the evidence base.
options.zh: 進一步調查可擴大證據基礎。

contrast.explanationZh: picture 在這裏比喻對事情的理解。

options.en: Teacher responses give a narrow picture of the queues; asking students will show what the wait is like for them.
options.zh: 教師回答只呈現排隊片面的情況；問學生才能了解他們實際等候的經驗。

options.en: The students may have useful experiences to share.
options.zh: 學生可能有有用經驗可分享。

options.en: Another survey could add information.
options.zh: 再做調查可以補充資訊。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句指出原資料遺漏的人，以及補足方法。

speaking.en: The first survey gave a narrow picture because students were not asked.
speaking.zh: 首輪調查沒有訪問學生，因此只呈現片面的情況。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出缺了哪一群人的觀點。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：博物館展覽只引用船主日記來介紹一次航程，尚未加入船員工作紀錄。策展人希望補足展覽。用一至兩句英文說明。
writing.selfCheckZh: 說明只見船主觀點的限制，並建議補入船員紀錄；不要說日記必定錯。

examples.en: The owner’s diary gives a narrow picture of the voyage, so the curator should add crew records to show daily work aboard.
examples.zh: 船主日記只呈現航程片面的情況，因此策展人應加入船員紀錄，展示船上日常工作。

examples.en: Visitors get a narrow picture if they read only the owner’s account; crew logs would add another perspective.
examples.zh: 訪客若只讀船主記述，得到的便是片面的情況；船員紀錄可加入另一個觀點。

takeaways.en: A single interview may give a narrow picture without being inaccurate.
takeaways.zh: 單一次訪問未必不準確，但可能只呈現片面的情況。

takeaways.en: The map gives a narrow picture of access if it omits the side entrance.
takeaways.zh: 地圖若漏掉側門，對出入路線便只呈現片面的情況。

options.en: The need for a record-label recommendation.
options.zh: 需要唱片公司推薦的規定。

options.en: The need to submit any recording.
options.zh: 提交錄音的規定。

options.en: The organisers’ review of recordings.
options.zh: 主辦方對錄音的審核。

options.en: The showcase’s online application form.
options.zh: 展示活動的網上申請表。

listening.explanationZh: 獨立音樂人不再須先獲唱片公司推薦。
listening.en: An online music showcase stopped requiring a record-label recommendation. Any independent musician could submit a demo. The change threw the gate wide open to new performers, though organisers still reviewed every recording.
listening.zh: 網上音樂展示不再要求唱片公司推薦；任何獨立音樂人都可提交示範錄音。改動大幅開放了新表演者的參與機會，雖然主辦方仍審核每份錄音。

options.en: Independent musicians could apply without a label.
options.zh: 獨立音樂人毋須唱片公司便可申請。

options.en: More performers could submit demos.
options.zh: 更多表演者可以提交示範錄音。

options.en: It threw the gate wide open to new performers.
options.zh: 它大幅開放了新表演者的參與機會。

options.en: It removed a recommendation requirement.
options.zh: 它取消了推薦要求。

options.en: First-time writers can apply directly; that throws the gate wide open to them.
options.zh: 首次投稿作者可直接申請；這大幅開放了他們的參與機會。

options.en: Every submitted piece will win a prize.
options.zh: 每篇投稿都會得獎。

options.en: The award has stopped reviewing submissions.
options.zh: 獎項已停止審核投稿。

scene.explanationZh: 自行投稿降低參與門檻，卻不保證入圍或得獎。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句把 gate 誤讀成實體建築？

options.en: A new application route can widen access.
options.zh: 新申請途徑可擴大參與機會。

options.en: The platform must have installed a larger metal gate.
options.zh: 平台一定安裝了更大的金屬閘門。

options.en: Selection can remain after applications open.

contrast.explanationZh: 這裏的 gate 是參與門檻的比喻。

options.en: It throws the gate wide open to applicants, but organisers still choose which demos enter the showcase.
options.zh: 改動大幅開放申請機會，但主辦方仍會甄選哪些示範錄音可參與展示。

options.en: More musicians can send demos now.
options.zh: 更多音樂人現在可寄出示範錄音。

options.en: The organisers will still review submissions.
options.zh: 主辦方仍會審核投稿。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句清楚分開申請機會和入選結果。

speaking.en: Removing the label requirement threw the gate wide open to independent musicians.
speaking.zh: 取消唱片公司推薦要求後，獨立音樂人的參與機會大幅開放。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出取消了哪項門檻。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：地方圖書館開放居民自行提交閱讀活動提案，毋須先獲學校推薦；圖書館仍按場地和內容作甄選。用一至兩句英文說明改動。
writing.selfCheckZh: 說明推薦門檻取消及後續甄選仍在；不要說每份提案必定獲准。

examples.en: The library threw the gate wide open to local organisers by removing the school-reference rule, while still reviewing each proposal.
examples.zh: 圖書館取消學校推薦規定，大幅開放本地活動籌辦者的參與機會，同時仍審核每份提案。

examples.en: Allowing residents to apply directly throws the gate wide open to new reading events, although space and content checks remain.

takeaways.en: Open submissions can throw the gate wide open without promising every applicant a place.
takeaways.zh: 開放投稿可大幅增加參與機會，但不保證每位申請者都有名額。

takeaways.en: The new grant rule threw the gate wide open to small community teams.
takeaways.zh: 新資助規則大幅開放小型社區團隊的參與機會。

sources.sentence: The viral claim was all smoke and no fire.

options.en: The dated notice showed normal hours and no closure order.
options.zh: 註明日期的通告顯示照常開放，亦無關閉命令。

options.en: The rumour appeared in several chats.
options.zh: 傳聞出現在幾個群組。

options.en: The library once changed its weekend hours.
options.zh: 圖書館曾調整週末時間。

options.en: The notice mentioned the library’s address.
options.zh: 通告提及圖書館地址。

listening.explanationZh: 可核查的最新通告沒有支持翌日關閉的說法。
listening.en: A rumour said the town library would close the next morning. The dated council notice showed normal opening hours and no closure order; the dated notice left the dramatic rumour looking all smoke and no fire.
listening.zh: 傳聞說市立圖書館翌日會關閉。市議會註明日期的通告顯示照常開放，也沒有關閉命令；註明日期的通告令這則誇張傳聞顯得聲勢大卻缺乏實質。

options.zh: 註明日期的通告沒有支持傳聞。

options.en: The office had issued no closure order.
options.zh: 辦事處沒有發出關閉命令。

options.en: The claim was all smoke and no fire.
options.zh: 這說法聲勢大卻缺乏實質。

options.en: The announced hours still showed the library open.
options.zh: 公布的時間仍顯示圖書館開放。

reply.promptEn: How did the dramatic closure rumour compare with the notice?

options.en: The month-long promise looks all smoke and no fire.
options.zh: 一個月的承諾看來聲勢大卻缺乏實質。

options.en: The independent test proves all batteries are unreliable.
options.zh: 獨立測試證明所有電池都不可靠。

options.en: The claim is well supported because its wording is bold.
options.zh: 這說法字體醒目，所以證據充分。

scene.explanationZh: 宣傳承諾與可核查測試結果不符。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句錯把傳聞的聲勢當成可靠證據？

options.en: The advertisement sounds impressive without adequate proof.
options.zh: 廣告聽來驚人，卻缺乏充分證據。

options.en: A widely repeated rumour must have a sound basis even without independent evidence.
options.zh: 傳聞被大量轉發，即使沒有獨立證據，也必定有可靠根據。

options.en: Check a claim against a dated source.
options.zh: 拿說法與註明日期的來源核對。

contrast.explanationZh: 本課強調聲勢與證據不相稱；轉發次數不等於證據。

options.en: The claim looks all smoke and no fire; today’s notice shows normal hours, so let us share the dated notice.
options.zh: 這說法看來聲勢大卻缺乏實質；今天的通告顯示照常開放，我們分享註明日期的通告吧。

options.en: The official notice lists normal hours.
options.zh: 官方通告列出正常開放時間。

options.en: We should check what the council posted today.
options.zh: 我們應查看市議會今天發布甚麼。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句比對具體證據，並建議分享可核查資料。

speaking.en: Against the dated council notice, the closure rumour looked all smoke and no fire.
speaking.zh: 與註明日期的市議會通告相比，關閉傳聞顯得聲勢大卻缺乏實質。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說出哪項通告與傳聞不符。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：新款耳機廣告聲稱一次充電可播放一整週，但沒有說明測試方式；一份獨立測試只測得一天。用一至兩句英文評價宣傳。
writing.selfCheckZh: 把誇張承諾與實際測試結果對比；不要推斷耳機完全不能使用。

examples.en: The week-long battery promise looks all smoke and no fire when the only independent test reports one day of playback.
examples.zh: 唯一的獨立測試只錄得一天播放時間，聲稱可用一整週的電池承諾便顯得聲勢大卻缺乏實質。

examples.en: Without a published test method, the slogan is all smoke and no fire beside the measured one-day result.
examples.zh: 沒有公布測試方法，這口號與測得的一天結果相比，便聲勢大卻缺乏實質。

glossary.zh: 可用一整週的電池承諾

takeaways.en: The headline was all smoke and no fire once the full report appeared.
takeaways.zh: 完整報告出現後，標題顯得聲勢大卻缺乏實質。

takeaways.en: A claim may be all smoke and no fire when no reliable figures support it.
takeaways.zh: 若沒有可靠數據支持，一項說法可能聲勢大卻缺乏實質。
